name: suite-tool-followups
body: The code that implements the three hygiene fixes on the suite's install+authoring surface: the shared suite lib's `runCli` (fix B — reuse the exported `NO_DB_ERROR` constant rather than a duplicated literal), the plan-update path — the `--no-fqn` sentinel on the CLI wrapper `apg.plan_cmd.plan_update` and its forwarding from the `apg_plan_add` tool (fix A) — and the `OPENCODE_PACKAGE_JSON` installer const in `src/main.rs` (fix C — pin `@opencode-ai/plugin` to the same version as `opencode-suite/package.json`). Nothing else changes.
